description: The authoritative post-award contract record(s) for a Ukraine ProZorro tender (keyless OpenProcurement contracting API): current status (active | terminated | cancelled), dateSigned, contract period, current value (AFTER amendments — the API does not keep the original signed amount as a separate field; the change rationale usually states it) and amountPaid, terminationDetails, every contract change/amendment (rationale, rationaleTypes, date published, dateSigned), contract documents with their datePublished, and milestones. Use this — not the tender — for anything after signing: the copy of the contract embedded in a tender is frozen when the tender completes and keeps saying `active` after the contract is amended or terminated. Pass a tender id (32-hex or UA-… tenderID) to get all of its contracts, or a contract's 32-hex id. Optional `as_of` (YYYY-MM-DD) splits changes and documents into those published on/before vs after that date and states whether the record's status at that date is known: the public API keeps NO revision history, so if the record was modified after `as_of` the status at `as_of` is reported as not available rather than inferred. The API carries no termination date field; this tool never invents one.

as_of.description: Optional cutoff date YYYY-MM-DD (or full ISO timestamp). Separates what was published on or before it from what came later, and says whether the status at that date can be established from the public record.

id.description: A tender id (internal 32-hex, e.g. "6a9dca3807a14b37bf82fb8ad2eae0c9", or human tenderID "UA-2026-07-13-009811-a") to return every contract of that tender, or a contract's own 32-hex id (the `contract.id` prozorro_get_tender returns).
